explanation: I searched Mathlib's Analysis/Distribution files (Sobolev.lean, TemperedDistribution.lean, Support.lean, TemperateGrowth.lean) for results about real-valued L^p functions embedded into complex tempered distributions via ofRealCLM. I found nothing like "a complex L^p representative of a distribution that comes from a real function can be taken to be real". Mathlib has no `ext_real` lemma for tempered distributions and no Sobolev-zero line-derivative statement of this kind.
